name: @devlenspro/mcp-server
stderr:
Usage: devlens [options] [command]

👆 DevLens - Point, capture, let Claude fix it

Options:
  -l, --log-level <level>  log level (debug|info|warn|error) (default: "info")
  -s, --silent             disable all logging (default: false)
  -V, --version            output the version number
  -h, --help               display help for command

Commands:
  start [options]          Start in LOCAL mode (WebSocket server on localhost)
  cloud [options]          Start in CLOUD mode (connect via relay server)
  generate-key             Generate a new API key (room ID) for cloud mode
  config [tool]            Configure MCP for AI tools (claude, cursor,
                           windsurf, manual)
  install [options]        🚀 Full auto-install: DevLens + Claude MCP + Ralph
                           (recommended)
  ralph                    🤖 Ralph autonomous coding commands
  help [command]           display help for command
